TAHOE CITY PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT
                                                                MEMORANDUM


    TO:           Board of Directors                    DATE:      October 9, 2026
    C:            Parks and Recreation
                  Committee
    FROM:         Will Stelter                          SUBJ:      Award Construction Contract for the Lake
                  Engineering Manager                              Forest Boat Ramp Maintenance Dredging
                                                                   Project
RECOMMENDATION: The Board of Directors take the following steps to award a construction contract for
the Lake Forest Boat Ramp Maintenance Dredging Project (Project):
         1.   Based on the Total Bid Price, identify the two bidders as:
              #1 F.W. Carson Co.                                                 $ 324,600
              #2 Longo, Inc.                                                     $ 388,850
         2.   Authorize the General Manager to execute a contract with the lowest responsive bidder, F.W. Carson
              Co., at $324,600.
         3.   Authorize the General Manager the authority to approve any change orders to the construction
              contract up to 10% of the total bid price less than or equal $32,460.
         4.   Amend the 2026 Project Budget to $502,856 based on construction contract award.
BACKGROUND: Bid proposals were received and opened for the above-referenced project on Monday,
October 5, 2026, at 1:00 pm. Two (2) bids were submitted, and the results are listed below.
The Engineer’s Estimate for this project is $208,000.
              Contractor                                                         Bid Amount
              #1 F.W. Carson Co.                                                 $ 324,600
              #2 Longo, Inc.                                                     $ 388,850

TAHOE CITY PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT
                                                         MEMORANDUM

 TO:          Board of Directors                 DATE:   October 7, 2026
 CC:          Parks   &           Recreation
              Committee

 FROM:        Will Stelter                       SUBJ:   Approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional
              Engineering Manager                        Service Agreement with Auerbach Engineering
                                                         Corp. for Construction Support Services for the
                                                         Lake Forest Boat Ramp Maintenance Dredging
                                                         Project.


RECOMMENDATION:
The Board of Directors authorizes the General Manager to amend (Amendment No. 2) the existing
Professional Services Agreement (Agreement) with Auerbach Engineering Corp. (AEC) for construction
support services for the Lake Forest Boat Ramp Maintenance Dredging Project (Project). This amendment
will be on a time and materials basis and will increase the current authorized not to exceed amount (NTE) for
the Agreement by $70,548.50 from $53,743.00 to $124,291.50.

BACKGROUND:
In late 2014 and early 2015, the District completed a comprehensive renovation of the Lake Forest Boat
Ramp to improve watercraft launching at the facility. One of these improvements was the dredging of the
launch area to a base elevation of 6,219 feet. Since these improvements, the boat ramp and launch area has
received an accumulation of silts and sands through natural processes. This creates a safety hazard to
launching watercraft and causes the floating docks to become uneven during lower water level years.

The Project involves dredging of approximately 400 cubic yards of material from the ramp and launch area.
In February of 2026, the Board authorized a resolution to call for bids for the Project. Award of the Project

   For discussion only.

   BACKGROUND:

   Over the last few months, staff have been developing the District’s 2027 operating and capital
   budgets for review and approval at the Board’s November budget workshop. A preliminary list of
   projects planned for 2027 was reviewed at the August Committee meetings.

   Attached are drafts of the 2027-2031 Capital Improvement Plans for Parks & Recreation to be
   reviewed during the October Committee and Board meetings. Input received at the Committee and
   Board meetings will be used by staff to develop the proposed District 2027-2031 Capital
   Improvement Plans and associated budgets to be presented for review and approval at the
